messages.subject: How to customize the SidebarPanel
parts:
Hi everyone,

I would like to extend the window size of the  dropdown list included in SidebarPanel.

This is the code...

 sidebarPanel(list(tags$head(tags$style(".span12 {background-color: white; }"))),
              selectInput("variable", "var",
              choices = c( "a" = "a", "b" = "b", "c" = "c", "d" = "d", "e" = "e",....)# n variables),
                            multiple=T, tags$style(type="text/css","#additemstolist {height:10000px}")
                )),

How can customize the display size of this dropdown?  The code line "tags$style(type="text/css","#additemstolist {height:10000px}")" doesn't increase the window size of items list....

Thanks

Best regards,
Carla
